notes.title: Ancient Arenas: Chariots - Recap Slitherine Next
notes.notes:
During the live event [b]Slitherine Next 2022[/b], we revealed the first video trailer of the new upcoming tactical racing game Ancient Arenas: Chariots

[previewyoutube=1-0VsSHojdc;full][/previewyoutube]

If you missed the exciting race’s gameplay explanation by the Game Director Patryck Nosek, you can watch it here: 

[previewyoutube=75YihFlanX4;full][/previewyoutube]

Ancient Arenas: Chariots is still in development and will be released in 2023. Stay tuned to our channels if you do not want to miss the latest news.

Wishlist now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536660/Ancient_Arenas_Chariots/

notes.title: Next? Slitherine
notes.notes:
[b]Slitherine Next[/b], the spiritual successor of our Home of Wargamers events, is coming soon.
Save the date: [b]December 13th at 16 pm GMT[/b] on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv/schedule?segmentID=4b0d1a22-f043-4b2c-bea9-4432b0a770bb]Twitch[/url]

It'll be the perfect occasion to learn more about upcoming games and get an insight directly from the developers. 

It will be [b]100% live[/b]: there will be no pre-recorded segments and we'll have a level of interaction with the players like never before. You'll be able to ask us anything and be answered directly by the developers.

Stay tuned for the full schedule!

notes.title: Slitherine are making a new ancient kart racing management game
notes.notes:
Brutal ancient horseracing game Ancient Arenas: Chariots and grand strategy sequel Field Of Glory: Kingdoms and have been revealed during Slitherine’s Home Of Wargamers stream today. Both games are still a way off from release, but public betas are quickly charging into view for each of them, with one set to arrive in the summer for Ancient Arenas, and one in the autumn for Field Of Glory. Have a watch of their reveal trailers below.
